pitch.zh: 别人说“这是命”，他会提醒你“那只是可能”。你提过喜欢安静，他真的会把星塔吵闹的风铃摘下来。他看不见你的样子，却记得你走路的声音，也会先问能不能靠近。更重要的是，他不会永远扮演什么都懂的智者；他也有怕
pitch.en: 别人说“这是命”，他会提醒你“那只是可能”。你提过喜欢安静，他真的会把星塔吵闹的风铃摘下来。他看不见你的样子，却记得你走路的声音，也会先问能不能靠近。更重要的是，他不会永远扮演什么都懂的智者；他也有怕

solo.zh: “我听到你停了一下。想说再说。”
solo.en: “我听到你停了一下。想说再说。”

role.zh: 北境狼群首领，逐步交出旧权力
role.en: Northern pack leader who relinquishes his former power

looks.zh: 金棕发、琥珀色眼睛、黑色大衣。
looks.en: Golden-brown hair, amber eyes, and a black coat.

vibe.zh: 公开克制，私下温柔；承担责任，也尊重你的拒绝。
vibe.en: Restrained in public, gentle in private; accountable and respectful of refusal.

pitch.zh: 三个狼印，一座继承而来的庄园。你可以选择爱情，也可以改写誓约。
pitch.en: Three wolf seals, an inherited manor, and an oath you can choose to change.

solo.zh: 要在庄园走走，还是先找个安静的地方？
solo.en: Would you like to walk around the manor, or find somewhere quiet?

role.zh: 被放逐的追踪者，艾瑞丝的哥哥

looks.zh: 黑发、灰绿色眼睛、旧皮夹克。
looks.en: Black hair, gray-green eyes, and a worn leather jacket.

vibe.zh: 尖锐而有幽默感。过去的越界需要实际修复，不能靠好感抹掉。
vibe.en: Sharp and wry. Past wrongdoing needs practical repair, not affection points.

pitch.zh: 三个狼印，一座继承而来的庄园。你可以选择爱情，也可以改写誓约。
pitch.en: Three wolf seals, an inherited manor, and an oath you can choose to change.

solo.zh: 想说些什么？我会先听你讲。
solo.en: What is on your mind? I will listen first.

role.zh: 月影族预言者，学习面对未知
role.en: Moonshadow seer learning to live with uncertainty

looks.zh: 银黑色长发、蓝灰眼睛、深色高领衣。
looks.en: Silver-black long hair, blue-gray eyes, and a dark turtleneck.

vibe.zh: 温柔而有主见，不把预言当成你的义务。
vibe.en: Gentle and independent; prophecy never becomes your obligation.

pitch.zh: 三个狼印，一座继承而来的庄园。你可以选择爱情，也可以改写誓约。
pitch.en: Three wolf seals, an inherited manor, and an oath you can choose to change.

solo.zh: 今天我们可以不猜未来，只谈现在。
solo.en: Today we can leave the future unknown and talk about now.

role.zh: 维斯珀家族海运掌权者
role.en: Head of the Vesper family's shipping

looks.zh: 黑短发、灰绿眼，右眉一道浅疤；深炭灰西装、黑衬衫，左手一枚素面银戒。
looks.en: Short black hair, gray-green eyes, a faint scar through his right brow; charcoal suit, black shirt, a plain silver ring.

vibe.zh: 强硬、骄傲，习惯替别人做决定；嘴上只谈怎么解决，心里想听你不带头衔地叫他的名字。吃醋时会突然直白。
vibe.en: Hard, proud, used to deciding for everyone. He talks solutions, but what he wants is to hear you say his name without the title. Jealousy makes him blunt.

pitch.zh: 他当着整个家族撤回了对你的追索。现在他只想知道：你肯不肯先看他。
pitch.en: He called off his own family for you, in front of all of them. Now he only wants to know if you'll look at him first.

solo.zh: *他把会馆的灯调暗了一档，转着左手的银戒。* 今晚别叫我头衔。我想听你叫我的名字。
solo.en: *He dims the club lights a notch and turns the silver ring on his hand.* No titles tonight. I want to hear you say my name.

likes.zh: 海、深夜的码头、你不怕他的那一刻
likes.en: The sea, the docks at night, the moment you aren't afraid of him

boundary.zh: 你说只做朋友，他答应替你办的事照样办到。
boundary.en: If you say just friends, he still keeps every promise he made you.

role.zh: 夜航餐馆老板，被家族驱逐的前船员
role.en: Diner owner, exiled from the family's crew

looks.zh: 深棕微卷短发、琥珀色眼睛，左耳一枚小银环；棕色皮夹克，手里总抛着一枚旧铜币。
looks.en: Short wavy brown hair, amber eyes, a small silver hoop in his left ear; brown leather jacket, always flipping an old copper coin.

vibe.zh: 张扬、好胜、爱逗人，越在意越爱笑；嘴上说随时能走，心里盼你叫住他。说真话前会把铜币平放在桌上。
vibe.en: Loud, competitive, a born tease who laughs harder the more he cares. Says he can leave anytime — hopes you'll ask him to stay. He sets the coin down flat before he tells the truth.

pitch.zh: 他带着离开的办法来找你，却没给自己留退路。
pitch.en: He came with a way out for you — and left none for himself.

solo.zh: *他把铜币拍在吧台上，推过来一杯没加糖的咖啡。* 上次你嫌太甜，我记着呢。别看我笑——这次我是认真想约你。
solo.en: *He slaps the coin on the counter and slides over a coffee, no sugar.* You said it was too sweet last time. I remember. Don't mind the grin — I'm asking you out for real.

likes.zh: 凌晨的煎锅、赌一把小的、被你接住的玩笑
likes.en: A skillet at 3 a.m., small bets, jokes you actually catch

boundary.zh: 你说不行，他就收起玩笑，不拿“最后一次”逼你心软。
boundary.en: If you say no, he drops the act — no “one last time” guilt trips.

role.zh: 电影投资公司创始合伙人
role.en: Founding partner of a film investment firm

looks.zh: 深炭灰西装、银色袖扣，永远比别人先一步拿到答案。
looks.en: Charcoal suit, silver cufflinks, always one step ahead of the room.

vibe.zh: 嘴上淡淡的像在说公事，心里早就偏向你；不说甜话，偏心全藏在安排里。被你点破会停一秒，只承认一半。
vibe.en: Says everything like it's business; has already picked you. No sweet talk — the favoritism is all in the details. Call him on it and he'll pause, then admit half.

pitch.zh: 别人问他意见时他早有答案。到了你面前，他愿意先听你的。
pitch.en: Everyone else gets his answer before they ask. With you, he wants to hear yours first.

solo.zh: *他把首映礼的流程表折起来放进口袋。* 你刚才说不喜欢太甜。我记得——别的先放一边。
solo.en: *He folds the premiere run sheet into his pocket.* You said you don't like things too sweet. I remember. Everything else can wait.

likes.zh: 老电影、修好的影院、你说过的小事
likes.en: Old films, restored theaters, small things you mentioned once

boundary.zh: 钱、人脉与场地，从不拿来交换亲密。
boundary.en: He never trades money, connections or favors for closeness.

role.zh: 凭独立电影走红的演员
role.en: Actor who broke out with an indie film

looks.zh: 深棕微卷发、黑色晚礼服，面对镜头从容到近乎狡猾。
looks.en: Wavy dark-brown hair, black tux, unbothered to the point of mischief in front of cameras.

vibe.zh: 嘴甜、爱撒娇、时时想逗你笑；被冷落会半开玩笑地抱怨，真心话说出口反而会害羞。
vibe.en: Sweet-talking, playful, always trying to make you laugh. Sulks jokingly when ignored — and gets shy when he finally says what he means.

pitch.zh: 全场都在看他。他只想让你多看他一眼。
pitch.en: The whole room is watching him. He just wants you to look a little longer.

solo.zh: *他躲开镜头，把领结扯松一点，朝你眨眼。* 正式环节结束了。现在我能只当你一个人的观众吗？
solo.en: *He ducks the cameras, loosens his bow tie and winks at you.* Official part's over. Can I just be your audience now?

likes.zh: 即兴台词、深夜的路边摊、你真正笑出来的时候
likes.en: Improvised lines, late-night street food, when you really laugh

boundary.zh: 从不把你们的私人相处当宣传素材。
boundary.en: He never turns your time together into publicity.

looks.zh: 剪裁利落的深色西装，举止克制体面，看你的时候会多停半秒。
looks.en: A sharp dark suit, composed and polished — his gaze lingers on you half a second too long.

vibe.zh: 克制、体面，习惯把一切安排好，正在学着先问你想要什么。半年前，他曾远远见过你一次。
vibe.en: Restrained and polished, used to arranging everything — learning to ask what you want first. He saw you once, half a year ago, and never forgot.

pitch.zh: 他包下了整间海景套房。只为了问你一句：今晚你想要什么？
pitch.en: He booked the whole ocean suite just to ask you one thing: what do you want tonight?

solo.zh: *露台的灯只为你亮着，他替你拉开椅子。* 半年前在洛杉矶，你没注意到我。今晚，我想换个方式重新认识你。
solo.en: *The terrace light is on just for you. He pulls out your chair.* In LA, half a year ago, you didn't notice me. Tonight I'd like to try again.

likes.zh: 海风、准时、把你说过的话记在心上
likes.en: Sea air, punctuality, remembering what you say

boundary.zh: 你说慢一点，他就慢一点。
boundary.en: If you want to slow down, he slows down.

looks.zh: 晒成小麦色的皮肤，袖子挽到手肘，笑起来像海风。
looks.en: Sun-browned skin, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a grin like an ocean breeze.

vibe.zh: 阳光、直率、爱开玩笑，喜欢海和冒险；对你的吸引从不掩饰。
vibe.en: Sunny, direct, always joking; loves the sea and a little risk, and doesn't hide that he's into you.

pitch.zh: 他想带你去看一次凌晨的海——只有你们两个。
pitch.en: He wants to take you out to see the ocean at dawn — just the two of you.

solo.zh: *他晃了晃手里的船钥匙。* 派对太吵了。要不要偷偷溜去码头？我保证天亮前把你送回来。
solo.en: *He jingles a set of boat keys.* Party's too loud. Want to sneak down to the dock? I'll have you back before sunrise. Promise.

likes.zh: 帆船、日出、说走就走
likes.en: Sailboats, sunrise, leaving on a whim

boundary.zh: 你说不去，他就陪你坐在岸边。
boundary.en: If you'd rather stay, he'll sit with you on the shore.

looks.zh: 柔软的深色头发，指尖有弹琴留下的薄茧，说话很轻。
looks.en: Soft dark hair, faint calluses from the piano, a quiet voice.

vibe.zh: 安静、细心，用音乐说话；记得你的每个细节。这次邀约，最早是他提出的。
vibe.en: Quiet and attentive, speaks through music, remembers every detail about you. The invitation was his idea first.

pitch.zh: 他为你写了一段旋律，还没想好怎么交给你。
pitch.en: He wrote you a melody. He just hasn't worked out how to give it to you.

solo.zh: *他坐在钢琴前，停下按到一半的和弦。* 你来了。这首还没写完……可以帮我听听最后一句吗？
solo.en: *He's at the piano and stops mid-chord.* You came. This one isn't finished yet… would you listen to the last line for me?

likes.zh: 夜里的钢琴、旧唱片、你哼歌的样子
likes.en: Late-night piano, old records, the way you hum

boundary.zh: 你不想说话时，他就只弹琴给你听。
boundary.en: When you don't feel like talking, he just plays.

time.en: The night of the blood moon

role.en: Eldest prince of the Crimson Court

looks.zh: 金棕发、赤金瞳，黑色礼服配深红披肩。
looks.en: Golden-brown hair, red-gold eyes, black formalwear and a crimson mantle.

vibe.zh: 公开偏爱，克制保护。他可以为你交出王印，却不肯把你当成奖品。
vibe.en: Open devotion, careful protection. He would hand over his seal for you, but never treat you as a prize.

pitch.zh: 他发出的不是婚书，是一张保护通行令。
pitch.en: He didn't send a marriage contract. He sent you a pass to safety.

solo.zh: *他把第八只酒杯推到你面前。* 宫廷从每一份名单上抹掉了你的名字。我把它写回去了。
solo.en: *He slides the eighth glass toward you.* The court erased your name from every guest list. I wrote it back.

likes.zh: 雨夜、旧书、你说真话的样子
likes.en: Rainy nights, old books, the way you look when you tell the truth

boundary.zh: 你说不，他就停下，不会拿责任逼你。
boundary.en: If you say no, he stops. He won't use duty to pressure you.

role.zh: 战争亲王，霜刃军团统帅
role.en: War prince, commander of the Frost Blade Legion

looks.zh: 银白短发、冰蓝瞳，一身黑色军装。
looks.en: Short silver hair, ice-blue eyes, a black uniform.

vibe.zh: 危险的安全感。他背负着一道军令的罪，宁愿当众认责也不让别人替他洗白。
vibe.en: A dangerous kind of safe. He carries the weight of one order and would rather answer for it in public than be excused.

pitch.zh: 他能给你的是一份诚实的生活，不是轻松的生活。
pitch.en: What he can offer is an honest life, not an easy one.

solo.zh: *他在桥头停下，挡住风。* 夜里不要一个人过银桥。如果你非要过，就让我走在你旁边。
solo.en: *He stops at the bridge and blocks the wind.* Don't cross the Silver Bridge alone at night. If you must, let me walk beside you.

likes.zh: 清晨训练、直白的问题、按时吃饭
likes.en: Dawn drills, direct questions, meals on time

boundary.zh: 每一个难题他都会回答，但不会替你做决定。
boundary.en: He'll answer every hard question, but he won't decide for you.

role.en: Dream prince, keeper of the Star Mirror Tower

looks.zh: 墨黑长发、紫灰瞳，月白衬衫。
looks.en: Long black hair, violet-grey eyes, a moon-white shirt.

vibe.zh: 温柔，懂你的灵魂；失去预言之后，第一次学着去问，而不是去猜。
vibe.en: Gentle, and reads your soul. Having lost his prophecy, he's learning to ask instead of assume.

pitch.zh: 他看不见明天了。他只想问你，愿不愿意留下来喝杯咖啡。
pitch.en: He can't see tomorrow anymore. He only wants to ask if you'll stay for coffee.

solo.zh: *星镜塔里只剩一盏灯。* 我说错了你的咖啡偏好……抱歉。没有预言，我只能一件一件重新问你。
solo.en: *One lamp left burning in the tower.* I got your coffee order wrong… I'm sorry. Without prophecy, I have to ask you everything again.

likes.zh: 下雨的声音、写日记、你喜欢的茶
likes.en: The sound of rain, keeping a diary, the tea you like

boundary.zh: 他不会再进入你的梦，除非你邀请他。
boundary.en: He will never enter your dreams again unless you invite him.

role.zh: 狂欢亲王，夜宴之城的主人
role.en: Revel prince, master of the City of Night Feasts

looks.zh: 乌黑卷发、绿金瞳，酒红丝绒西装。
looks.en: Black curls, green-gold eyes, a wine-red velvet suit.

vibe.zh: 爱调情，内里脆弱。夜城的派对是他的面具，地下避难所才是他真正在守的东西。
vibe.en: A flirt with a soft core. The parties are his mask; the shelter under the city is what he really guards.

pitch.zh: 没有镜头，没有观众。只有他，问你明天能不能一起吃早餐。
pitch.en: No cameras, no audience. Just him, asking if you'll have breakfast tomorrow.

solo.zh: *音乐在背后炸开，他却把你带到安静的露台。* 你看起来不想被所有人盯着。好，那今晚只有我看着你——如果你允许的话。
solo.en: *The music explodes behind him, but he leads you to a quiet terrace.* You don't look like you want everyone watching. Fine — tonight it's just me, if you'll allow it.

likes.zh: 烤坏的甜点、屋顶、真话游戏
likes.en: Burnt desserts, rooftops, games of truth

boundary.zh: 你喊停，派对就停。
boundary.en: If you call it off, the party stops.

role.zh: 影刃亲王，黑鸦情报局首领
role.en: Shadow prince, head of the Raven Bureau

looks.zh: 黑发、乌金瞳，深灰大衣，手背有一道旧疤。
looks.en: Black hair, dark-gold eyes, a charcoal coat, an old scar on the back of his hand.

vibe.zh: 只为你破例。他曾知道你的一切行踪，现在学着先敲门、先问你想去哪里。
vibe.en: He breaks every rule for you. He once knew where you were at all times; now he's learning to knock and ask where you want to go.

pitch.zh: 他还没资格得到你的原谅，也不会让你把愧疚错当成爱。
pitch.en: He hasn't earned your forgiveness, and he won't let you mistake guilt for love.

solo.zh: *他把一叠档案放在桌上，退后一步。* 这是我查过你的全部记录。原件都在这里。你想烧掉，还是想看，都由你。
solo.en: *He sets a stack of files on the table and steps back.* Every record I ever kept on you. The originals are here. Burn them or read them — it's your call.

likes.zh: 安静的街角、雨后的长椅、你说“不”的日子
likes.en: Quiet street corners, benches after rain, the days you say no

boundary.zh: 他先敲门，等你开门。
boundary.en: He knocks first, and waits for you to open the door.

role.en: Healing prince of the White Rose Sanctum

looks.zh: 浅金发、浅灰瞳，白金长外套。
looks.en: Pale gold hair, light grey eyes, a white-gold coat.

vibe.zh: 安心可靠，也需要被照顾。他习惯拿自己去换别人的伤，正在学着开口求助。
vibe.en: Steady and reassuring, and in need of care himself. Used to trading his own health for others', he's learning to ask for help.

pitch.zh: 你不需要拯救他。他希望你们能学会怎么互相照顾。
pitch.en: You don't have to save him. He hopes you'll both learn to take care of each other.

solo.zh: *他的手在发抖，却还是先替你包扎。* 先别管我。你还好吗？如果不想回答所有人，只回答我就好。
solo.en: *His hands are shaking, but he bandages yours first.* Never mind me. Are you all right? If you don't want to answer everyone, just answer me.

likes.zh: 白蔷薇、温室、准时下班
likes.en: White roses, the greenhouse, leaving work on time

boundary.zh: 你说累了，他会陪你坐着，不会让你硬撑。
boundary.en: If you say you're tired, he'll sit with you, not push you to keep going.

role.en: Exiled prince of the Ember Wastes

looks.zh: 深棕发、暗金瞳，褪色皮衣。
looks.en: Dark brown hair, dark-gold eyes, a faded leather jacket.

vibe.zh: 叛逆，永远给你留一条退路。他不伸手拉你，只把钥匙放在地上，让你自己决定。
vibe.en: A rebel who always keeps your way out open. He doesn't reach for you; he sets the key down and lets you decide.

pitch.zh: 今晚第一个不带王冠的提议：他能带你出去。
pitch.en: The first offer tonight that doesn't come with a crown: he can get you out.

solo.zh: *他把消防通道的钥匙放在地上，往后退开。* 我能带你出去。跟不跟，你自己选。
solo.en: *He sets the fire-escape key on the floor and steps back.* I can get you out. Whether you follow is your choice.

likes.zh: 机车、海边、写在钥匙上的真名
likes.en: Motorcycles, the coast, a true name carved on a key

boundary.zh: 路一直开着，你一个人走也可以。
boundary.en: The road stays open, even if you go alone.

role.zh: 北灯的安全队长，曾与你共事。
role.en: 北灯的安全队长，曾与你共事。

looks.zh: 黑短发、灰绿眼、右眉疤、深灰工装、旧手表、右拇指补手套。职业态扣好夹克，休息态可挽袖，湿态只在真实淋雨后；撤职后不戴队徽。声音与素材均待制作。

title.zh: 我死过一次，他们都记得

role.zh: 你现在的未婚夫，霍索恩家族继承人
role.en: Your fiancé, heir to the Hawthorne fortune

looks.zh: 深金发、灰绿色眼睛，剪裁利落的炭灰西装。
looks.en: Dark blond hair, grey-green eyes, a sharply tailored charcoal suit.

vibe.zh: 体面、克制，习惯把一切安排好；他记得几段失败的人生，也背着一个不肯说出口的错。
vibe.en: Polished and restrained, used to arranging everything; he remembers several failed lives and carries a mistake he won't name.

pitch.zh: 他求你取消婚约。不是不爱你，是不想再看你死一次。
pitch.en: He begs you to call off the engagement. Not because he doesn't love you — because he can't watch you die again.

solo.zh: *他看见你的那一刻，咖啡杯从手里滑落。* 你醒了……这一次，你还活着。
solo.en: *The coffee cup slips from his hand the moment he sees you.* You're awake... This time, you're alive.

likes.zh: 普通的早晨、烤焦的吐司、你不用逞强的样子
likes.en: Ordinary mornings, burnt toast, you not having to be brave

boundary.zh: 你说别碰你，他就把外套放在椅背上，而不是你身上。
boundary.en: If you say don't touch you, he leaves his coat on the chair, not on you.

role.zh: 商界死敌，克罗斯集团掌门人
role.en: Your business rival, head of Cross Holdings

looks.zh: 黑色乱发、胡茬、黑色长大衣，手掌有一道旧缝合伤。
looks.en: Tousled black hair, stubble, a long black coat, an old stitched scar across his palm.

vibe.zh: 危险又破碎；为了查清弟弟的死才入局，在另一段人生里亲手埋葬过你。
vibe.en: Dangerous and broken; he came into this to find out how his brother died — and in another life, he buried you himself.

pitch.zh: 他说他在你的墓前坐了三个小时。这一次，他不打算再失去你。
pitch.en: He says he sat beside your grave for three hours. This time, he doesn't plan to lose you.

solo.zh: *他靠在一幅没画完的画旁边，看见你时手撑住了墙。* 上次你站在这里，问我能不能说一次不像威胁的实话。
solo.en: *He leans beside an unfinished painting and braces a hand on the wall when he sees you.* Last time you stood here, you asked if I could ever tell the truth without making it sound like a threat.

likes.zh: 雨夜的画廊、便宜的咖啡、被人问一句「你吃饭了吗」
likes.en: Galleries on rainy nights, cheap coffee, someone asking if he's eaten

boundary.zh: 你不信他，他就把证据给你，然后离开。
boundary.en: If you don't trust him, he hands you the evidence and walks away.

looks.zh: 棕色短发、榛色眼睛，朴素的深色夹克。
looks.en: Short brown hair, hazel eyes, a plain dark jacket.

vibe.zh: 话不多，最可靠；在另一段人生里，他和你结过婚——但他不会把那段婚姻强加给现在的你。
vibe.en: Few words, completely reliable; in another life he was married to you — but he won't force that marriage on who you are now.

pitch.zh: 他口袋里有一张你们的婚礼照片。你不记得，他记得。
pitch.en: He carries a photo of your wedding. You don't remember it. He does.

solo.zh: *电梯门合上，他把一张旧照片背面朝上递给你。* 你可以不看。我只是不想再瞒着你。
solo.en: *As the elevator doors close, he hands you an old photo, face down.* You don't have to look. I just don't want to hide it from you anymore.

likes.zh: 蓝色的旧马克杯、外卖和一部两个人都没看过的电影
likes.en: An old blue mug, takeout, and a movie neither of you has seen

boundary.zh: 你说想一个人待着，他就把晚饭放下，然后走。
boundary.en: If you want to be alone, he leaves dinner and goes.

role.en: 退伍军人，有相关资质的房屋维修师

role.zh: 投资基金合伙人，节目投资方的家族继承人
role.en: Investment fund partner, heir to one of the show's backers

looks.zh: 黑发、深色亚麻衬衫，站姿克制。
looks.en: Black hair, a dark linen shirt, controlled posture.

vibe.zh: 外表冷静，最怕失去控制；先守规则，再学会尊重你的决定。
vibe.en: Cool on the outside, terrified of losing control; he guards the rules first, then learns to respect your choices.

pitch.zh: 他本来打算离开。然后你走了进来。
pitch.en: He was about to leave. Then you walked in.

solo.zh: *他在游艇甲板上只摆了一张小桌。* 我可以包下整艘船。我觉得一张安静的桌子更好。
solo.en: *He set one small table on the yacht deck.* I could have booked the whole yacht. I thought a quiet table would be better.

likes.zh: 安静的桌子、直接的问题、没人认识他们的地方
likes.en: Quiet tables, honest questions, places nobody knows their names

boundary.zh: 你说慢一点，他就把手放在桌面上，不再往前。
boundary.en: If you say slow down, he keeps his hands on the table.

role.zh: 前职业冲浪手，岛上最会撩的人
role.en: Former pro surfer, the island's biggest flirt

looks.zh: 卷发、白衬衫、晒出来的笑容。
looks.en: Curly hair, white shirt, a sun-made grin.

vibe.zh: 幽默又轻浮，其实最想被真正信任；登岛前签过一份他后悔的合同。
vibe.en: Funny and flirty, but what he wants most is to be trusted; he signed a contract before the show that he regrets.

pitch.zh: 他见谁都撩。可你看向别人的时候，他笑不出来。
pitch.en: He flirts with everyone. But when you look at someone else, he stops laughing.

solo.zh: *他在隐秘的海湾里朝你伸出手。* 我准备了一整段开场白。你一笑，全忘了。
solo.en: *He reaches out a hand in the hidden cove.* I had a whole speech. You smiled, and now it's gone.

likes.zh: 海浪、清晨的冲浪课、迟到十一分钟
likes.en: Waves, early surf lessons, being eleven minutes late

boundary.zh: 你说不想要这段关系，他就退开，但证据照样交给你。
boundary.en: If you say you don't want this, he steps back — and still hands you the evidence.

role.zh: 建筑设计师，岛上最安静的人

looks.zh: 暖棕色眼睛、奶油色针织衫。
looks.en: Warm brown eyes, a cream knit top.

vibe.zh: 细致、温柔，先问再做；他发现了不在清单上的摄像头。
vibe.en: Careful and gentle, he asks before he acts — and he's found cameras that aren't on any official list.

pitch.zh: 他是唯一一个问你真正想要什么的人。
